import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# 1. Transaction amount distribution
axes[0, 0].bar(range(len(df)), df['amount'], color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amounts', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Index')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, v in enumerate(df['amount']):
    axes[0, 0].text(i, v + 5, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Transaction types distribution
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = ['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue']
axes[0, 1].pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors[:len(type_counts)], startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Types Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Hour of day distribution
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='lightseagreen', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Amount by transaction type
type_amounts = df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()
bars = axes[1, 1].bar(type_amounts.index, type_amounts.values, color='gold', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Amount by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5,
                   f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
